author: NeonRei
body:
Those boots are okay but honestly there are better boots out there for defense and resistance.
Definitely upgrade your chest piece as there's plenty of room for improvement there.
Focus on word-based skills as mentioned by others since you have a very good chest piece. Also consider using a pet that provides you your turns like Ori Golem.
Sustain is much more important than damage. Unless you're getting zeros
